headline: Executive session on resignation of Chief Financial Officer and contract talks for Broad Rock Middle School Assistant Principal.
summary: The committee will meet in executive session to discuss the resignation of the Chief Financial Officer and contract negotiation terms for the Assistant Principal at Broad Rock Middle School. These same items will then be addressed in open session.

plain_text:
Friday, August 14, 2026
South Kingstown School Committee Executive Session and Special Meeting
South Kingstown School Department
Administration Building - Conference Room
307 Curtis Corner Road
Wakefield, RI 02879
**************************
Posted: 8/12/2026
1. 4:30 PM - Call to Order/Roll Call
A. Roll Call
B. Call to Order
2. Executive Session
A. The School Committee may seek to Recess to Executive Session for Discussion and/or Action regarding those
items of business exempt from open meetings under RIGL 42-46-4 and A: Discussion/Action: Job Performance -
Resignation of Chief Financial Officer (RIGL 42-46-5(a)(1)); B: Discussion/Action: Personnel - Terms of Contract
Negotiation - Assistant Principal, Broad Rock Middle School (RIGL 42-46-5(a)(1)). Individuals have been notified,
including their right to have any discussion held in open session.
3. 5:00 PM - Open Session
A. Roll Call
B. Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag
C. Motion to Seal Minutes of Executive Session
D .  Disclosure of Votes Taken in Executive Session
4. School Committee Business
A. Discussion/Action: Job Performance - Resignation of Chief Financial Officer
B. Discussion/Action: Personnel - Terms of Contract Negotiation - Assistant Principal, Broad Rock Middle School
5. Adjournment
A. Adjourn
The order of business maybe altered or suspended at any meeting by a majority of those present. A vote may be taken on any
item on this agenda. Each regular meeting shall continue until such time as all matters on the agenda have been considered and
acted upon, provided, however, that at 10 pm the chair shall call for actions required before adjournment and a subsequent
motion to adjourn. The school committee may go into executive session under Title 42, Ch. 46, Section 5 of the General Laws of
Rhode Island.
The South Kingstown School Department does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex (including pregnancy,
gender identity, and sexual orientation), parental status, national origin, age, disability, family medical history or genetic
information, political affiliation, military service, or other non-merit based factors, in accordance with applicable laws and
regulations.
Any changes to this Agenda will be published on the school district’s website, at the two public locations required by R.I. Gen.
Laws § 42-46-6, and transmitted to the Secretary of State’s website at least forty-eight (48) hours in advance of the meeting.
